lines: Felicia
「Ahahaha! Onee-san's doing kinda okay! But only kinda!!」
The girl's scythe left a black trail behind it, and from there, monsters emerged.
Older Brother
「Hiiih?!」
Astaroth
「Burn to nothing♪」
When the monsters touched Astaroth's wall of flame, they became charred and disappeared, just from that.
Felicia
Felicia
「Who are you, Onee-san......?! For your flames to burn my dark underlings in an instant......」
Astaroth
「I'm Astaroth. You also appear to be pretty good, despite appearances, “Felly”-chan♪」
Felicia
The girl glared at Astaroth in silence.
She had confidence in herself that she wouldn't lose, no matter whether to demon or Taimanin.
If she were to be soundly thrashed, that would have to be either by her father, or at least someone related to him by blood.
But the woman in front of her eyes might possess the power to even rival her father.
Felicia
「......I'll let you off the hook for today.」
The girl said, and was suddenly gone from the scene.
Astaroth
「I see. She was a somewhat challenging girl.」
Astaroth
「At this rate, there might be someone even stronger waiting further in♪」
Astaroth made her eyes light up, as if to say that she had finally had a fight worth fighting.
However, seeing the battle between the two of them, the brothers had completely lost their nerve.
Older Brother
「That strength, even from a kid......?!」
Younger Brother
「I-Is this safe......? I don't wanna die after all, Aniki!」
Astaroth
「Pathetic. Didn't you say you don't care what happens to you?」
Younger Brother
The two of them exchanged glances awkwardly.
Having witnessed monsters dying extremely easily in front of their eyes, they had become intimidated by her strength and terrifyingness.
Astaroth
「What? You guys said you'd do it, didn't you? There's no going back now♪」
Older Brother
「Uuh, uuuh......」
It was too late for them to realize that they had made a deal with a horrifying devil.
While harbouring fear, the men simply followed Astaroth.
